_doc: Σ₀ local-model adapter registry. Operator-editable overlay onto the built-in defaults in apps/lantern-garage/lib/local-model-registry.js (merged by id, TTL-cached ~60s). See docs/SIGMA0-MODEL-ADAPTER.md. DEFAULT LOCAL CODER (OSS-BASELINE 2026-07-06, #2171): the supported Apache-2.0 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B via the standard Ollama :11434 (already pulled) — it leads coding/reasoning/default on the 8GB box. The owned PLT coder (keystone-sigma0-plt, ADR-0011) is kept as a research coder on its :11435 shim but sorts BEHIND Qwen (unverified + shim-dependent) until its on-box HumanEval head-to-head (#2173) flips verified:true. Kernel stays Ouro/keystone-ft on :11434 (Ouro promotion to coding is gated on the loop-value experiment #2178); Three Doors keeps lantern-csf-dream on :11434. Per-model endpoints are honored by endpointFor(). vramGB gates against the box (VRAM_BUDGET_GB, default 8).
_ladder_doc: RAM-tiered local-first ESCALATION LADDER (added 2026-07-09). selectChain() is capability-gated by the DETECTED box (VRAM_BUDGET_GB, default 8): among models whose vramGB<=budget it leads with the highest capabilityScore — BUT verified:false rungs always sort BEHIND every reproduced peer (External Reality Rule), so the NEW rungs (1.5b/3b/14b/gpt-oss:20b/32b) never auto-lead over the on-box-verified qwen2.5-coder:latest until each is reproduced here. Effect: the ladder AUTO-CLIMBS with hardware — on the current 8GB RTX 3070 only the <=~6GB rungs fit so Qwen-7B still leads; raise VRAM_BUDGET_GB (bigger box / cloud L4) and the 14B/20B/32B rungs light up with ZERO code change. vramGB values are Q4_K_M GGUF footprints incl. ctx/overhead (VENDOR/PREDICTED); capabilityScore are vendor HumanEval anchors (PREDICTED) — flip verified:true only when a probe/eval log reproduces the number on-box. To activate a rung the operator must `ollama pull` the tag. gpt-oss:20b is MoE (~3.6B active of ~21B) so it is CPU-compute-cheap but still needs all experts RAM-resident.

models.note: Default local coder (OSS-BASELINE #2171): supported Apache-2.0 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B via Ollama :11434. VERIFIED on-box (#2173): coding-golden exec pass@1 0.96 (24/25), leaderboard row qwen25coder-onbox-2173. capabilityScore stays the vendor HumanEval anchor (0.86), not the easy coding-golden 0.96. Leads coding/reasoning/default on the 8GB box; single-pass so the Core wraps it in loopedReason() (grounding by default).

Owned PLT research coder (ADR-0011, LoopCoder-V2 lineage). Sorts BEHIND the Qwen2.5-Coder default (#2171) — unverified AND shim-dependent (:11435; falls back to cloud if down). Its on-box HumanEval head-to-head vs Qwen is the gate to lead again. Serve: python models/keystone-sigma0-plt/serve_keystone_plt.py --model D:/keystone-sigma0-plt-ckpt --port 11435 --dtype 4bit.

Σ₀ Convergence-Core kernel — Ouro-1.4B, native Q-exit (arXiv 2510.25741). KERNEL/RESEARCH-ONLY; not a coding/default candidate. Promotion to the coding slot is gated on the loop-value experiment (#2178). Force Ouro-first (research) with LOCAL_CAPABILITY_FIRST=0.
Keystone kernel fine-tune of Ouro (kernel chain lead, #894).
Dream/RP-tuned model — Three Doors surface only (never a tool assistant).

Potato-box / fast-draft rung. Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B @ Q4 (~1GB). VENDOR HumanEval ~0.60 (PREDICTED, verified:false → sorts behind the on-box Qwen-7B). Fits sub-8GB / CPU-only boxes. Candidate cheap first-attempt for verify-gated local-first (escalate to a bigger rung / cloud on verify-fail). Requires `ollama pull qwen2.5-coder:1.5b`.

Fast rung. Qwen2.5-Coder-3B @ Q4 (~2GB). VENDOR HumanEval ~0.72 (PREDICTED, verified:false). Fits 8GB with headroom; the cheap first-attempt rung on constrained boxes. Requires `ollama pull qwen2.5-coder:3b`.

Mid rung (12-16GB boxes). Qwen2.5-Coder-14B @ Q4 (~9GB). VENDOR HumanEval ~0.90 (PREDICTED, verified:false). Dormant on the 8GB box (11>8); leads once VRAM_BUDGET_GB>=11. Requires `ollama pull qwen2.5-coder:14b`.

Mid rung (~16GB boxes) — MoE (~3.6B active of ~21B): CPU-compute-cheap but all experts must be RAM-resident (~14GB). Strong native tool-calling → good agent-loop lead when RAM allows. VENDOR-claimed reasoning/coding/tool-use (PREDICTED, verified:false). Dormant on the 8GB box. Requires `ollama pull gpt-oss:20b`.

Top rung (>=24GB box / cloud L4). Qwen2.5-Coder-32B @ Q4 (~20GB). VENDOR HumanEval ~0.92 (PREDICTED, verified:false). Dormant on the 8GB box; leads once VRAM_BUDGET_GB>=22. Requires `ollama pull qwen2.5-coder:32b`.
